task_summary: Run an offline Trivy scan on /root/package-lock.json to identify HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities and write results to a CSV file.
decomposition_rationale: This task is a single end-to-end pipeline: run Trivy offline, parse JSON output, and write CSV. The background research provides a near-complete Python script. A single skill covering Trivy execution and CSV generation is sufficient, as the concerns are tightly coupled and splitting them would create unnecessary complexity.

skills.name: evo-trivy-offline-audit
skills.description: Executes Trivy in offline mode against a package-lock.json file, parses the JSON output to extract HIGH/CRITICAL vulnerabilities with CVSS scores, and generates a CSV report with columns: Package, Version, CVE_ID, Severity, CVSS_Score, Fixed_Version, Title, Url.
skills.responsibility: Complete end-to-end pipeline: configure and invoke Trivy CLI with correct offline flags, parse nested JSON output (including vendor-prioritized CVSS score extraction and missing FixedVersion handling), deduplicate results, and write formatted CSV output.
dr_sections: Trivy Command-Line Interface Configuration for Offline Environments
Offline Database Architecture and Cache Directory Structure
Trivy JSON Output Schema and Data Representation
Implementation: Python Automation and Data Pipeline
Common Pitfalls and Edge Cases in Trivy Offline Scanning
